result.title: Stereo LWIR-RGB Automatic Labeling for Low-Light Camera-Based VRU Detection
result.summary: VRU detection in low-light conditions is a key component in ensuring VRU safety during the most collision prone time of the day. Currently, advances in low-light detection are limited due to the lack of large scale datasets and automated labeling methods. Most autolabeling methods use RGB detections as their labels source, which cannot be replicated in low-light conditions. To fill this gap in this paper we present an automated pipeline for low-light VRU labeling. We use LWIR-RGB image pairs and source our labels from LWIR as VRUs differentiate from the background due to their body temperature. Unlike our previous work that relied on a complex hardware setup to align the two modalities, we perform this experiment using a LWIR-RGB stereo setup, lowering hardware complexity and cost, making the pipeline easier to reproduce. We evaluate method end-to-end on a dataset collected in the capital region of Finland. Models trained on our generated labels beat both off-the-shelf baselines and models fine tuned on a hand labeled subset on F1, mAP@50 and LAMR metrics when tested on a manually labeled dataset, and the result holds for two different LWIR detectors. This shows that low-light VRU autolabeling can be made both accessible and effective without specialized alignment hardware.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出低光条件下 VRU 检测的自动标注流程：用 LWIR-RGB 立体相机对，以物体体温在 LWIR 中易区分的特性作为标签来源，替代低光下不可用的 RGB 标注，并在芬兰采集的数据上端到端评测，所得标签训练的模型在 F1、mAP@50、LAMR 上优于现成基线和手标子集微调模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文本身属低光感知与自动标注，不涉及 latent 推理或 VLM 状态生成；但其「用信号更易分离的 LWIR 模态充当监督源、跨模态生成标签且不依赖特殊对齐硬件」的做法，可能为 LVR 中训练监督信号的获取与跨模态证据筛选提供可供核查的线索。
